The '''''Fury''-class Imperial Interceptor''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and its resultant [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:FurySchematics-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Fury'' schematics]]
''Fury''-class [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were commonly utilized by prominent [[Sith Warrior]]s and [[Sith Inquisitor]]s as their bases of operations throughout important missions on which they were assigned. For this the interior included a large communications room with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], as well as cabins for the ship's crew and a conference room.

The [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] was located in the center at the front of the ship. It featured numerous computer panels as well as seats for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and co-pilot, all overlooked by the commanding officer's seat in the center of the bridge. The weaponry of the Imperial interceptor was four high powered<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Enmity-class Precision Laser Cannon|''Enmity''-class Precision Laser Cannon]]s and [[Heavy Seeker Missile]]s<ref name="GoH" /> to inflict a large amount of damage in a short time along with military grade shielding in order to survive [[Space warfare/Legends|space battles]] and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] situations. The Imperial Interceptor was also easily upgradable for a variety of situations whether to destroy an enemy shuttle to stripping the weaponry of the larger Republic warships in order to lessen damage for the allied forces.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
[[File:Onslaught_of_the_Sith_Empire.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Two Fury-class transports [[Battle of Korriban|taking on]] [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|Jedi forces]] protecting [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].]]
At least three of these transports were present when the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[Battle of Korriban|retook Korriban]] in the early years of the Great Galactic War, one of them carrying [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], to the space station near the planet. The [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were stationed in the hangars of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Imperial battlecruisers]] and used by personnel within the Empire. One such owner was [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], who used his ''Fury''-class transport during his hunt for [[Exal Kressh]].

The ''Fury''-class Imperial Interceptor was widely produced and used regularly within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] during the reconquest of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] along with a force of 4 [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]], 45 Fury Imperial Interceptors and 192 [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|ISF interceptors]] was present and under the command of [[Darth Malgus]] prior to an assault on the Core Worlds during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Empire's Wrath's Fury-class Imperial interceptor|another ship of this class]] was given to a [[Empire's Wrath|promising young Sith Lord]] under the apprenticeship of [[Darth Baras]]. They would use the ship as a transport to numerous worlds in order to do their master's bidding until [[Quesh]], where they were betrayed by Baras. The ship would later become the mobile base for the newly christened Lord Wrath and their allies, leading up to the events that would have them [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|defeat]] their former master.

Around the beginning of the [[Galactic War]], [[Darth Nox's Fury-class Imperial interceptor|another ''Fury''-class]] ship was given to a [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]] by the newly promoted [[Darth Zash]] in order to find the lost artifacts of [[Tulak Hord]] that would help Zash steal her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice's]] body for her own. After the death of Zash in the aftermath of a [[Duel in the Dark Temple|battle]] between the master and the apprentice that the inquisitor used the ship as their mobile base of operation to fight against [[Darth Thanaton]] and in the search of [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] to gain more power to defeat him.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Fury-class_Imperial_interceptor_concept_art.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art by Ryan Dening]]
{{Quote|You were given this ship by the Empire, so it wasn't some evil shop concocted out of the dark side of the Force or something. It's as if a TIE interceptor and the ''Millennium Falcon'' made out and had a baby. It's got the docking room at the back, and it's got some turrets on the sides, but it also has these big triangular wings.|Senior Concept Artist Ryan Dening|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The ''Fury''-class interceptor was designed by the concept art team under [[Ryan Dening]], the senior concept artist for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the personal starship for Sith players. When they began developing the vessel, the team had already decided on a geometric style of smooth surfaces and a large number of angles for the Imperial ships, and they were unable to deviate a great deal from this style as the ship was intended to be factory-issue.<ref name="Art" />
